summary.text: Bill Powers is a Republican state senator from Clarksville representing Tennessee Senate District 22 (Montgomery County), where he has served as a member of the 111th through 114th General Assemblies. He chairs the Senate Calendar Committee and is vice-chair of the Senate Education Committee.

paragraphs.text: Powers was born on March 10, 1957, and holds a B.A. from the University of Tennessee, Knoxville, with honors.
He is the managing partner of the Wyatt-Johnson Automotive Group.
He is married to Fran and they have three adult children.

Before the Senate, Powers was elected to two terms on the Clarksville City Council and has served as chairman of Clarksville Gas & Water, the city Board of Zoning Appeals, and Clarksville Parks & Recreation.
He is a graduate of Leadership Middle Tennessee and has been a vice president of the CMCSS Education Foundation and a member of the University of Tennessee Board of Governors.
In the Senate he also sits on the Finance, Ways, and Means, Transportation and Safety, and Ethics committees.
